from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img53 = np.array(Image.open("/work/observations/obs_0053.png"))

# Looking right down the back of the sofa!
# Sofa backrest top edge:
# Let us find where the top flat surface of the backrest is:
backrest = np.argwhere((img53[:,:,0] > 70) & (img53[:,:,0] < 120) & (img53[:,:,1] > 80) & (img53[:,:,1] < 130) & (img53[:,:,2] > 90) & (img53[:,:,2] < 150))

    if len(row) > 0:
        print(f"y={y}: sofa x from {row[0]} to {row[-1]}")
